prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: Five countries were not part of the 12-country initial expansion list: **the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Mexico, and South Korea**. The June 2018 expansion added 12 countries, bringing availability to 17 markets.
